newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were little changed on Thursday as falls in crude futures offset Wednesday's late surge.

One ARA player was heard offering product at $134 fob NWE although some dealers said this was overdone, considering a deal heard done late on Wednesday for a cargo of North Sea material at $138 cif NWE.
Two oil majors were heard in the market to buy straight-run, against healthy offers, but no deals were heard done.
High sulphur cargoes continue to trickle out of Baltic ports but dealers were unwilling to assess values for Russians.
